info.name: Restaurant POS API
info.description: Restaurant POS API — Bearer auth, POS-style order validation (submitted totals must match server), saved POST examples, E2E scenarios. Service fee on DINE_IN only.

item.name: 00 — E2E Scenarios
item.description: Run each sub-folder with Collection Runner (in order, 1 iteration). Scenario 4 step 3: set Runner iterations to 100 for queue wrap setup.
